questions.question: Step [14] of the close order, the root: its first reading names 142 banks, 139 of them clean and equal at HEAD, READY False (data/b769_root_banks.txt :148). The three not read clean are the prev-mode pass's text banks data/b769_prevrun_act.txt, data/b769_prevrun_standing-a1.txt and data/b769_prevrun_standing-a2.txt, each untracked (data/b769_root_banks.txt :84). Each carries the two archives' own file names, printed by the pass's reading of the papers' repository's changed files, and each is held untracked because (4)(d) keeps the archives out of the relay beyond the manifest's sha256 and its counts and the relay is a public repository. The root names every file under data/ whose name opens with the act's number and that its exclusions do not take out, and after the lock no tool or bank tracked at the lock is edited (N4), so no tool at this act can mask the three or take them out of the root. No reader of the three text banks stands in the suite's template, the close tool or the act module beyond the prev-mode pass's own order guard, which has run. Which route does the root take?

options.label: Hold the three out (Recommended)
options.description: The three banks are moved out of data/ before the root, each copied by its verified absolute path to a held folder in the scratchpad and read back by sha256 before its working file is removed, as the refused lock gate's two outputs were held at events (125); the root is computed over the other 139 banks, the three stay out of data/ through the post-push suite, and the closing message names each with its sha256, the masking of the prev-mode reading carried to b770 as a key. Nothing of the archives' names goes to the relay. The root covers 139 banks where the act wrote 142; the score clauses of N1 to N5 name none of the three.

options.label: Commit the three
options.description: The three are committed and pushed before the root, as b768's prev-mode banks were, so the root names all 142; the two archives' own file names then stand in the relay, a public repository, against (4)(d)'s words and N5's clause on the names of the author's own data. N5 reads REFUTED on this route.

options.label: Another route
options.description: The author names the root's route in the answer's own words; the close waits at step [14] until then, nothing committed or moved.
